scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web,imports,notifications 'npm run dev -w @keel/api' 'npm run dev -w @keel/web' 'npm run dev -w @keel/artifact-worker' 'npm run dev -w @keel/notification-worker'
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build -w @keel/web && esbuild apps/api/src/server.ts --bundle --platform=node --packages=external --format=esm --outfile=apps/api/dist/server.js --sourcemap && esbuild apps/artifact-worker/src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --packages=external --format=esm --outfile=apps/artifact-worker/dist/main.js --sourcemap && esbuild apps/agent-gateway/src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --packages=external --format=esm --outfile=apps/agent-gateway/dist/main.js && esbuild apps/workflow-worker/src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --packages=external --format=esm --outfile=apps/workflow-worker/dist/main.js && tsx scripts/build-workflows.ts && esbuild apps/operations/src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --packages=external --format=esm --outfile=apps/operations/dist/main.js && esbuild apps/notification-worker/src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --packages=external --format=esm --outfile=apps/notification-worker/dist/main.js
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.format: npm run format:prettier && eslint . --fix && npm run format:prettier && tsx scripts/format-sql.ts
scripts.format:check: npm run lint && prettier --check apps packages scripts tests examples infrastructure docs .github *.json *.ts *.mjs README.md && tsx scripts/format-sql.ts --check
scripts.infra:storage: docker compose -f infrastructure/docker/compose.yml --profile storage up -d --wait s3
scripts.format:prettier: prettier --write apps packages scripts tests examples infrastructure docs .github *.json *.ts *.mjs README.md
scripts.infra:execution: docker compose -f infrastructure/docker/compose.yml --profile execution up -d --wait temporal
scripts.test:execution: npm run agent:build && tsx scripts/build-workflows.ts && vitest run --config vitest.execution.config.ts
